problem.logQuestMissing: The quest log names a quest that isn't in this campaign.
problem.rewardCoin: A reward is in a coin this campaign doesn't use.
problem.wholeNumber: {what} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
problem.endBeforeStart: A quest can't end before it starts.
problem.deadlineBeforeStart: A quest's deadline can't be before it starts.
problem.parentNotInCampaign: The parent quest isn't in this campaign.
problem.parentCycle: A quest can't sit under itself or one of its own sub-quests.
problem.frontNotInCampaign: That front isn't in this campaign.
quest.subQuestsMoveUp: Its sub-quests move up to its parent. Sessions that logged it keep their notes.
links.title: Who and where
links.help: NPCs, places, factions and items that matter to this quest. Each one shows the quest on its article, under “In quests”.
fronts.empty: No fronts yet. A front is a threat moving behind the scenes: a villain, a cult, a war. Give it grim portents (what it does next if nobody stops it) and an impending doom, then group its quests under it.
fronts.loose_one: {n} quest isn't under any front. Pick one in a quest's Clock & front tab.
fronts.loose_other: {n} quests aren't under any front. Pick one in a quest's Clock & front tab.
fronts.hintTick: Tick the clock; when it fills: {portent}
fronts.perPortentNote: The clock fills once per portent ({segments} segments each).
fronts.noPortents: None yet. Add them with Edit.
fronts.doomNear: Every portent has come to pass or the clock is full: the doom is at hand. Set the front to “{doom}” or “{averted}” in Edit.
fronts.noQuests: No quest under this front yet.
frontEditor.name: Name
frontEditor.namePlaceholder: e.g. The Cult of the Drowned God
frontEditor.threatPlaceholder: Who or what, and what it wants. e.g. A drowned priest raising the dead to flood the valley.
frontEditor.portentsHelp: What the threat does next, in order, when the party doesn't get in the way. Advance marks the next one as happened.
frontEditor.portentPlaceholder: The fishermen of Saltmere stop coming home
frontEditor.doomPlaceholder: What happens if nobody stops it. e.g. The valley drowns; the dead walk its shores.
frontEditor.clockHelp: Optional: a countdown to the doom. Advance ticks it by one.
frontEditor.perPortentHelp: Each grim portent happens only when the clock fills up. Then Advance becomes “Next portent”, which starts the clock over.
frontEditor.perPortentTotal_one: With {n} portent, that's {ticks} ticks in all.
frontEditor.perPortentTotal_other: With {n} portents, that's {ticks} ticks in all.
frontEditor.deleteBody: Its quests stay, no longer under a front.
questLog.title: Quests this session
questLog.help: What moved: hooks the party picked up, quests they advanced, finished or failed. Saving the session updates those quests and adds this to their history.
questLog.newPlaceholder: …or a new hook: who sent the letter?
questLog.removeHint: Remove from this session (the quest keeps its current state)
questLog.rewardsAdded: Its rewards were added to this session's XP and loot.
questMap.couldNotLoad: Could not load the saved layout.
questMap.resetHint: Forget where you dragged nodes: back to the automatic layout
questMap.hint: Drag nodes to arrange the map; click one to open it.
questMap.empty: No quests yet. Create some on the Quests tab: they, their fronts, clues and the people and places involved show up here.
clues.none: No clues yet. The Three Clue Rule: give every conclusion the party must reach at least three clues, in different places.
clues.coverage_one: {revealed} of {total} revealed · {n} hidden clue placed somewhere
clues.coverage_other: {revealed} of {total} revealed · {n} hidden clues placed somewhere
clues.underThree: Fewer than three: the party could miss it (Three Clue Rule).
clues.title: Secrets & clues
clues.help: Short facts the party can discover, each placed with the people, places or things that could reveal it. Don't tie a clue to one scene: if they miss it there, it can come out elsewhere.
clues.placeholder: The baron's seal on the letter is a forgery
clues.addWhereLabel: Add where the clue can be found
clockTab.frontHelp: The threat this quest is part of. Fronts are on the Sessions page's Fronts tab.
clockTab.noFronts: No fronts yet. Create one on the Sessions page's Fronts tab to group quests under a threat.
clockTab.title: Progress clock
clockTab.help: A danger closing in, a deadline or a long effort. Tick it as things happen, from here, the quest view or a session's Quests tab.
rewards.help: When a session logs this quest as completed, it offers to add these to that session's XP, coins and loot (to the party stash).
dates.noCalendar: The campaign's calendar is missing: pick another one in the campaign's settings to give quests in-world dates.
dates.startedHint: When the party picked it up.
dates.deadlineHint: When it's too late: the ritual completes, the caravan leaves. Shown on the calendar and the board.
dates.endedHint: When it was completed, failed or given up.
dates.help: In-world dates, in the campaign's calendar. They show on the Calendars page, on the day they fall. Today is {date}.
board.hint: Drag cards between columns, or focus one and use Alt + arrow keys.
view.title: Quest
view.noObjectives: No objectives yet. Add them with Edit.
view.noHistory: No session has logged it yet. Log it from a session's Quests tab.
editor.notesHelp: Your notes: the truth behind it, what the villain wants, how it could end. They save as you type.
editor.notesAfterCreate: Create the quest first; its notes open here right after.
editor.title: Title
editor.summaryPlaceholder: The hook, in a line or two: who wants what, and why the party should care.
editor.objectivesHelp: The steps to see it through. Optional ones don't count towards its progress. Sessions can tick them off as the party gets there.

coin.sp.name: Silver piece
coin.ep.name: Electrum piece

problem.recipient: Loot and coins go to a character of this campaign's party, or to the party stash.

problem.coinLineCoin: A coin line uses a coin this campaign doesn't have.

problem.playDateFormat: The play date must look like 2026-09-27.
problem.sessionEndBeforeStart: The in-world end can't be before the start.

session.label: Session {n}
header.tab.sessionsHint: Sessions, quests, fronts and the relationship map
header.tab.writerHint: Outline, plot threads and the story so far
manager.noCharacters: No characters yet. Add them in the campaign's settings.
manager.needCalendar: Sessions record in-world dates, so the world needs a calendar first.
manager.startCampaign: Start a campaign: its party, its coins and the calendar its dates are read in. Then log every session you play.
manager.noSessions: No sessions yet. After your next game, log it here: what happened, who they met, what they found.
campaignEditor.coinsHelp: Each coin's value is counted in the smallest coin (value 1).
campaignEditor.name: Name
campaignEditor.couldNotLoadPcs: Could not load the player characters.
campaignEditor.partyHelp: Party members are Player Character articles; each one's player comes from its Controlling Player field. Changes here are saved right away.
campaignEditor.noParty: No characters in the party yet.
campaignEditor.addPc: Add a player character to the party…
campaignEditor.addPcLabel: Add a player character to the party
campaignEditor.removeBody: They leave the party. Someone who already played or received loot can't be removed: mark them retired instead.
campaignEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: The premise, the table, the tone…
campaignEditor.partyAfterCreate: Once it's created you can add the party's characters.
campaignEditor.deleteBody: The campaign and its party list are removed for good. A campaign that still has sessions can't be deleted: archive it instead.
sessionView.deleteBody: The session, its loot, coins and XP leave the campaign's totals. Its number becomes free again.
sessionEditor.lootHelp: Type an item, or link an Item article. Who got it keeps the inventory history straight.
sessionEditor.coinsHelp: Found, paid or earned. A negative amount is money spent or lost.
sessionEditor.whoPlayedHelp: The session's XP is split evenly among those who played. Type a number next to someone to give them a different amount; leave XP empty for milestone games.
sessionEditor.emptyParty: The party is empty. Add characters in the campaign's settings.
sessionEditor.couldNotMoveDate: Could not move the date (it may have changed elsewhere). The session itself is saved.
sessionEditor.title: Edit session {n}
sessionEditor.noCalendar: The campaign's calendar is missing: pick another one in the campaign's settings to set in-world dates.
sessionEditor.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start.
sessionEditor.recapHelp: What happened, in your words. It saves as you type.
sessionEditor.noRecap: This session has no recap document.
sessionEditor.eventsPlaceholder: The bridge collapsed under the ogre
sessionEditor.decisionsHint: Big choices that shape what comes next.
sessionEditor.nextPlaceholder: Where they left off, what to prepare…
sessionEditor.involvedHint: NPCs met, places visited, factions and items that mattered. Each article shows this session in its backlinks.
sessionEditor.moveBody: The session is saved. It ends on {end}, after the world's current date ({current}). Move the current date to the end of this session?
problem.maxSecrets: A session has at most {max} secrets.
problem.sessionNotInCampaign: That session isn't in this campaign.
problem.linkedQuest: A linked quest isn't in this campaign.
problem.linkedFront: A linked front isn't in this campaign.
